# HUD

`cinnabar:extension/hud@0.1.0`

The mod's retained gameplay HUD layer and the vanilla HUD elements around it.
Every function except `set-label` requires hud authority.

**Grants:** `hud`, except set-label, which needs no grant.

<a id="type-element-state"></a>

### `element-state`

Whether vanilla draws the element this frame, ignoring hiding, and where. `bounds`
covers what vanilla draws: the drawn row of shanks for `hunger`, not its renderer
node; the effect icons for `status-effects`; the cursor for `crosshair`; the sidebar's
rows for `sidebar`. None while vanilla lays the element out nowhere.

```wit
record element-state {
    element: vanilla-element,
    visible: bool,
    bounds: option<rect>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `element` | `vanilla-element` |  |
| `visible` | `bool` |  |
| `bounds` | `option<rect>` |  |

Types: [`rect`](hud.md#type-rect), [`vanilla-element`](hud.md#type-vanilla-element).

## Functions

<a id="set-label"></a>

### `set-label`

```wit
set-label: func(text: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces this mod's label. Empty text removes it; invalid text is rejected.

<a id="local-message"></a>

### `local-message`

```wit
local-message: func(text: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Adds one bounded local-only system chat line after a successful callback.

<a id="set-surface"></a>

### `set-surface`

```wit
set-surface: func(json: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces the mod's JSON-UI layer, drawn over gameplay below vanilla screens and never
hit-tested. The JSON is a bounded surface: `screen`, `document`, `bindings`,
`collections` and `transitions`, as panel surfaces. Empty text removes the layer.

<a id="update-surface"></a>

### `update-surface`

```wit
update-surface: func(json: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Sparse patch of the current layer; omitted names keep their values. `remove_bindings`
lists bound names to unbind first, each once, none also set by the patch and at most
the binding limit; a removed name the document still reads draws as never bound.
`bindings` then replaces every binding, `binding_changes` sets the named ones and
`collection_order` reorders collections. `controls` maps top-level control names of
the document, without namespace and optionally with an `@` base as a document key, to
a replacement control object, or to null to remove one. The patched document is
validated as `set-surface` validates a whole one, and only the controls whose
resolution reads a replaced definition, embedded ones included, are laid out again.

### `measure-text`

<a id="set-hidden-elements"></a>

### `set-hidden-elements`

```wit
set-hidden-elements: func(elements: list<vanilla-element>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Retained; the listed elements are not drawn. An empty list restores them all.

Types: [`vanilla-element`](hud.md#type-vanilla-element).
